title: Jonah and the Gravity
author: Quentin Nakamura
blurb: Dominic Okafor, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
